rules: A dataset diagnosis maps to a MediSync profile only when both name the same disease.
tier1_profile is the exact profile name from ml-engine/data/dataset.csv (41 curated profiles), including its original spelling.
tier2_profiles lists Tier 2 knowledge-base profiles (disease_symptom_kb.v1.json) only when the name is the same disease name apart from case or spacing.
Narrower, broader or merely related profiles are not accepted (see notAccepted).
A prediction is correct when the predicted profile name equals tier1_profile or one of tier2_profiles (case-insensitive, trimmed).

allergy.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

notAccepted: Osteoarthristis (Tier 1): a specific arthritis type with its own profile
Rheumatoid arthritis (Tier 2): a specific arthritis type
Acute bronchospasm (Tier 2): a symptom-level condition, not asthma

chicken pox.reason: Same disease; Tier 2 differs only in spacing.
notAccepted: Shingles (herpes zoster) (Tier 2): same virus, different disease

common cold.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

diabetes.reason: Same disease name in Tier 1 (profile name has a trailing space in dataset.csv, trimmed by the engine).
notAccepted: Diabetes insipidus (Tier 2): unrelated disease despite the name
Erythema multiforme (Tier 2): one possible reaction pattern, not the same label
Athlete's foot (Tier 2): one specific fungal infection, narrower
Aspergillosis, Cryptococcosis, Histoplasmosis (Tier 2): specific systemic mycoses, narrower

gastroesophageal reflux disease.reason: GERD is the standard abbreviation of gastroesophageal reflux disease.
notAccepted: Esophagitis, Gastritis (Tier 2): related but different conditions

hypertension.reason: Same disease name in Tier 1 (profile name has a trailing space in dataset.csv, trimmed by the engine).

impetigo.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

notAccepted: hepatitis A/B/C/D/E, Alcoholic hepatitis, Chronic cholestasis (Tier 1), Liver disease (Tier 2): causes of jaundice, not the same label

migraine.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

peptic ulcer disease.reason: Same disease; the Tier 1 profile name carries a spelling error from its source file.
notAccepted: Gastritis, Gastrointestinal hemorrhage (Tier 2): related but different conditions

pneumonia.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

psoriasis.reason: Same disease name in both tiers.

notAccepted: Cystitis (Tier 2): one form of urinary tract infection, narrower
Bladder disorder, Urethral disorder (Tier 2): not infections specifically
